_help: Copy this file to scripts/espn_cookies.json (never uploaded to GitHub) to run updates on your computer.
On fantasy.espn.com (logged in), click the lock icon left of the address bar > Cookies > espn.com > Cookies,
and copy the Content of espn_s2 and SWID (keep the curly braces). Treat them like a password.
For the automatic weekly update, add the same two values as GitHub secrets named ESPN_S2 and ESPN_SWID.
